title: 3dDTtoNoisyDWI
description: Generate a synthetic set of DWI measures with a given SNR from an AFNI-style DT file and a set of gradients. This can be useful for simulations and testing.

dt_file.description: Diffusion tensor file with six bricks of DT components ordered in the AFNI manner: Dxx,Dxy,Dyy,Dxz,Dyz,Dzz.
dt_file.title: DT file

grad_file.description: Text file of gradients arranged in three columns. There should be no row of all zeros representing the b=0 line.
grad_file.title: Gradient file

noise_dwi.description: Fractional value of noise in DWIs. FF = sigma/S0 = 1/SNR0. For example, FF=0.05 corresponds to SNR0=20.
noise_dwi.title: Noise fraction in DWI

noise_b0.description: Optional fraction of Rician noise in the b=0 reference image. If not provided, FF2=FF.
noise_b0.title: Noise fraction in B0

prefix.description: Output file name prefix. Will have N+1 bricks when GRADFILE has N rows of gradients.
prefix.title: Output file prefix

mask.description: Optional mask within which to calculate uncertainty. Data should be masked already otherwise.
mask.title: Mask file

bval.description: Optional DW factor to use if DT values are scaled to something physical. Default is BB=1.
bval.title: B-value factor

s0.description: Optional reference b=0 signal strength. Default value is SS=1000.
s0.title: Reference b=0 signal strength
